message: Hey John, Timothy just joins my family and I want to play a good role as his step-father. How's Timothy doing today? Is there anything that I need to pay attention to? - Mark
Today everything goes well in the daycare center. Kids really enjoyed the tower building competition. Timothy built the tallest block tower in the playgroup. - Sarah

One thing I noticed is that Alex is not very well-behaved. During the break, he had a fight with Timothy. I criticized both of them but I do feel Alex is the one to blame. He seems to have problem interacting with several other kids as well. - Sarah
I noticed Timothy was a bit withdrawn today, seemed a bit upset after the interaction with Alex. - Sarah
Alex had another incident today, he pushed Timothy during playtime. We might need to set up a meeting with Alex's parents again. - Sarah
